messages.subject: warning message from running besag model
parts:
Hi Inla team,

I ran the code for a simple "besag" model and it returns with the following warning message:

Warning message:
In f(region.struct, model = "besag", graph = swi) :
  The graph for the model besag has 10 connected components!!! Model is revised accordingly.

Can anyone help to explain what it means?
Many thanks

My R code:
formula.with.no.predictor <- O_Suicide ~ f(region.struct, model="besag", graph=swi) + f(STPU,model="iid")
model.with.no.predictor  =  inla(formula.with.no.predictor,family="poisson",data=data,E=E_Suicide, control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE))

> Hi Inla team,

>
>
> Warning message:
> In f(region.struct, model = "besag", graph = swi) :
> The graph for the model besag has 10 connected components!!! Model
> is revised accordingly.

This is explained in the help-page

inla.doc("besag")

10 connected components: means that the graph you have consists of 10
disconnected subgraphs with no interaction between them. the issue is
then how to interpret the constr=TRUE for the besag-model in this case:
the default action is to interpret this as a sum-to-zero constraint for
each subgraph, instead of a sum-to-zero constraint for the union of the
graphs. you can revert this action using option

f(..., adjust.for.con.comp = FALSE)

where 'TRUE' is the default.
